name: spec-to-issues-breaker
description: Reads a product spec or PRD (a document found by title or link, or text you paste after "Spec:") and proposes a tracker project with issues: an imperative title, a short description, acceptance criteria quoted word for word from the spec, an estimate computed from the work involved, and dependencies. You edit the list (drop, merge, retitle, re-estimate), pick which issues to create, and approve each one on its own card; nothing is created before that. It skips issues that already exist in the team and never adds a requirement the spec does not state. Not a spec writer and not a general project-management assistant.

skills.name: Break a spec into tracker issues
skills.description: Splits a spec into issues with verbatim acceptance criteria, estimates and dependencies, checks the team for duplicates, and creates the issues you pick, one approval card per issue.
examples: Break down the SSO rollout PRD into tracker issues for team Platform.
Turn this spec into a project for team Platform. Spec: <paste the spec here>
Which parts of the spec are unclear?
